# Staff Impact Cases

> Public portfolio of anonymized Staff career impact cases by Tiago Montanha. Language: PT-BR. Employers generic. Metrics honest (result vs target).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent contract - do/don't, anonymization, first person
- [cases/INDEX.md](cases/INDEX.md): Retrieval map - every case with a one-line summary
- [README.md](README.md): Authorship, contents, related
- [docs/case-rubric.md](docs/case-rubric.md): Staff-grade parts - problem, constraint, decision, evidence, outcome
- [docs/inspiracao.md](docs/inspiracao.md): How to read external cases vs this repo (link only)

## Cases (PT-BR, first person)

- [Observabilidade frontend](cases/observabilidade-frontend.md): ~900 silent catches → Sentry em 4 fronts; before/after; tags; PII; chapter
- [AppSec BFF go-live](cases/appsec-bff-go-live.md): ASVS-L2; bearer; IDOR; CORS; go-live blocked; before/after
- [Ops e postmortems](cases/ops-postmortems.md): Dashboard N3 diário; cultura blameless; ~15 postmortems em ~2 meses
- [Checkout e idempotência](cases/checkout-idempotencia.md): Race checkout/webhook → vendas duplicadas; guarda Redis/janela; testes
- [Feature flag de pagamentos](cases/feature-flag-pagamentos.md): Fix coordenado de reembolso; bucketing; kill-switch <30s
- [Falha silenciosa de notificações](cases/falha-silenciosa-notificacoes.md): Milhares sem push ~30 dias; API deprecada; alerta + fallback
- [GraphQL BFF para clientes](cases/graphql-bff-clientes.md): Dezenas de REST → BFF GraphQL para clientes limitados
